record_scope_reconstruction: September18,2023 has two canonical road phases: Ruse/Giurgiu cars and trucks both directions, and entry to Bulgaria at Kardam/Negru Vodă. Official notice also mentions nearby protests at Vidin and Durankulak, but does not add those sites to the two recorded closure phases. Ruse slow-machine protest was on the approach roundabout; Kardam restriction evolved from certain trucks to all inbound vehicles.
